$schema_comment: Versioned temporary exceptions for yarn audit:policy. Each entry must include id, module, severity, rationale, residual_risk, and remove_by or follow_up_plan.

exceptions.title: React Router: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
exceptions.exploitability: Requires React Router RSC mode. KitchenFlow CRA SPA does not enable RSC data routes or server action deserialization.
exceptions.action: Allowlisted temporarily; stay on react-router 7.18.x compatible with CRA until a planned bundler/router migration.
exceptions.residual_risk: Low for current CRA SPA surface; would become material if RSC mode were enabled without upgrading.
exceptions.follow_up_plan: Remove when migrating off CRA to a stack that can adopt react-router 8.x (or Vite + RR8). Track under subsequent frontend platform plan / ADR.
